paragraphs.en: Few-step autoregressive video generation with Elastic Forcing. Five-step generation samples from our autoregressive Wan-14B model, post-trained for 23 hours on 8 H200 GPUs.
paragraphs.zh: 基于弹性强制的少步自回归视频生成。 我们的自回归 Wan-14B 模型在五步生成中的样本，该模型在 8 块 H200 GPU 上进行了 23 小时的后续训练。

sents.en: Few-step autoregressive video generation with Elastic Forcing.
sents.zh: 基于弹性强制的少步自回归视频生成。

sents.en: Five-step generation samples from our autoregressive Wan-14B model, post-trained for 23 hours on 8 H200 GPUs.
sents.zh: 我们的自回归 Wan-14B 模型在五步生成中的样本，该模型在 8 块 H200 GPU 上进行了 23 小时的后续训练。

paragraphs.en: Few-step autoregressive video generation commonly relies on Distribution Matching Distillation (DMD), requiring a bidirectional diffusion teacher and an online fake-score model. We instead learn the rollout distribution directly from reference videos, eliminating both score models during post-training. Our framework minimizes maximum mean discrepancy (MMD) in frozen self-supervised video representation spaces, using a hybrid Nyström–Monte Carlo estimator to balance approximation bias and sampling variance. Memory-efficient replay and gradient subsampling make this objective practical. Using the same architecture and initialization as Self-Forcing, our 1.3B model improves the VBench Total score from 83.80 to 84.64 while retaining 17 FPS. Removing auxiliary score models also enables 14B post-training on eight H200 GPUs. Beyond distillation, learning from reference videos enables the acquisition of new visual styles, semantic concepts, and spatial priors without a target-specific diffusion teacher.
paragraphs.zh: 少步自回归视频生成通常依赖分布匹配蒸馏（DMD），这需要双向扩散教师模型和在线伪评分模型。 我们转而直接从参考视频中学习展开分布，从而在训练后阶段完全消除了两种评分模型。 我们的框架通过混合 Nyström–Monte Carlo 估计器来平衡近似偏差与采样方差，在冻结的自监督视频表示空间中最小化最大平均差异（MMD）。 内存高效的重复播放和梯度子采样使该目标具有实际可行性。 在与 Self-Forcing 使用相同架构和初始化的情况下，我们的 13 亿参数模型将 VBench Total 分数从 83.80 提升至 84.64，同时保持了 17 FPS 的帧率。 移除辅助评分模型也使得在八块 H200 GPU 上进行 140 亿参数的训练成为可能。 除了蒸馏之外，从参考视频中学习还能在没有特定目标扩散教师的情况下获取新的视觉风格、语义概念和空间先验知识。

paragraphs.en: Streaming video generation [ 12 , 30 , 48 ] is becoming increasingly important for applications that require interactive and continuous synthesis, including game simulation [ 71 , 34 ] , virtual livestream interaction [ 94 ] , world modeling [ 8 , 83 ] , and embodied intelligence [ 79 , 11 ] . Streaming requires both causal continuation and low-latency synthesis, motivating few-step autoregressive models that generate each chunk through a short denoising trajectory. Denoising-based training with noisy or self-resampled histories [ 12 , 30 ] addresses imperfect context, but does not directly optimize the distribution produced by a fixed few-step sampler. Self Forcing [ 37 ] further addresses this setting through distributional post-training on the generator’s own autoregressive rollouts.
paragraphs.zh: 流式视频生成 [ 12 , 30 , 48 ] 对于需要交互式、连续合成的应用（包括游戏模拟 [ 71 , 34 ]、虚拟直播互动 [ 94 ]、世界建模 [ 8 , 83 ] 和具身智能 [ 79 , 11 ]）正变得日益重要。 流式生成既需要因果延续性，也需要低延迟合成，这推动了少步自回归模型的发展，这些模型通过较短的去噪轨迹生成每个片段。 使用含噪或自我重采样历史 [ 12 , 30 ] 的去噪基训练可以应对不完整的上下文问题，但并未直接优化固定少步采样器所生成的分布。 Self Forcing [ 37 ] 则通过利用生成器自身的自回归输出进行分布后训练，进一步解决了这一问题。

paragraphs.en: Most Self-Forcing-based methods adopt Distribution Matching Distillation (DMD) [ 87 ] , which obtains distributional gradients from a pretrained bidirectional diffusion teacher and an auxiliary model estimating the generated distribution’s scores. Maintaining these score networks incurs substantial training overhead, while teacher-based supervision bounds the students capabilities by the teacher’s knowledge. This raises a natural question: can we optimize autoregressive rollouts directly against reference videos, without relying on auxiliary score models?
paragraphs.zh: 大多数基于自我强制的方法都采用了分布匹配蒸馏（DMD）[87]，该方法从预训练的双向扩散教师模型和一个估计生成分布得分的辅助模型中获取分布梯度。 维护这些得分网络会产生巨大的训练开销，而基于教师的监督则使学生的能力受到教师知识的限制。 这引出了一个自然的问题：我们能否直接根据参考视频优化自回归展开过程，而不依赖辅助得分模型？

paragraphs.en: Maximum Mean Discrepancy (MMD) [ 29 ] offers a sample-based alternative by matching distributions through kernel comparisons, and has been explored for image generation [ 46 , 20 , 44 , 18 , 23 ] . However, small reference and generated minibatches can yield noisy training signals [ 7 , 23 ] , while increasing their sizes is particularly costly for videos. Making sample-based supervision practical therefore requires reliable estimates within the memory and computation constraints of video training, rather than simply relying on larger batches.
paragraphs.zh: 最大均值差异（MMD）[ 29 ] 提供了一种基于样本的替代方法，通过核函数比较来匹配分布，并且已被用于图像生成研究 [ 46 , 20 , 44 , 18 , 23 ] 。 然而，较小的参考和生成的迷你批量可能会产生噪声训练信号 [ 7 , 23 ] ，而增大其规模对于视频而言尤其成本高昂。 因此，要使基于样本的监督方法具有实际可行性，就需要在视频训练的内存和计算限制内获得可靠的估计，而不是仅仅依赖更大的批量。

paragraphs.en: We introduce Elastic Forcing , an efficient sample-based framework for post-training few-step autoregressive video generators. We retain Self Forcing’s rollout procedure but replace DMD with MMD in frozen representation spaces that capture video appearance and temporal dynamics. Reference videos directly define the training target, eliminating the need for either a diffusion teacher or an online fake-score model during distributional post-training.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出 Elastic Forcing，这是一种高效的基于样本的框架，适用于训练后的少步自回归视频生成器。 我们保留了 Self Forcing 的展开流程，但在用于捕捉视频外观和时序动态的冻结表示空间中，将 DMD 替换为 MMD。 参考视频直接定义了训练目标，从而在分布性后训练阶段无需扩散教师模型或在线虚假评分模型。

paragraphs.en: Our design treats the fixed reference distribution and the evolving generated distribution differently. On the reference side, a hybrid estimator combines a persistent, finite-rank Nyström summary of the full reference collection with Monte Carlo estimates from sampled references. The persistent component reduces reference-sampling variance, while the sampled component reduces the approximation bias of finite-rank compression. Each update thus incorporates reference statistics beyond its minibatch without exhaustive comparisons against the full collection. On the generated side, estimation–differentiation decoupling evaluates MMD interactions over a large rollout population in representation space, then backpropagates through only a randomly sampled subset. Appropriate rescaling yields a conditionally unbiased estimate of the evaluated full-batch gradient, allowing all evaluated rollouts to inform the objective while only a subset incurs generator backpropagation.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的设计对固定的参考分布和不断演化的生成分布采取了不同的处理方式。 在参考端，一种混合估计器将完整参考集合的持久有限秩 Nyström 摘要与从采样参考中获得的蒙特卡洛估计相结合。 持久成分降低了参考采样的方差，而采样成分则减少了有限秩压缩带来的近似偏差。 因此，每次更新都能在不与完整集合进行穷尽比较的情况下，融入超出当前小批量之外的参考统计信息。 在生成端，估计-微分解耦方法会在表示空间中针对大规模展开种群评估 MMD 相互作用，然后仅通过随机采样的子集进行反向传播。 经过适当的重新缩放，可以获得所评估的完整批梯度的一种条件无偏估计，这使得所有被评估的展开都能对目标函数产生贡献，而只有其中一部分会引发生成器的反向传播。

paragraphs.en: Under matched initialization and evaluation with a 1.3B generator, Elastic Forcing achieves a VBench [ 38 ] Total score of 84.64, compared with 83.80 for Self Forcing, while retaining the same inference efficiency. Training 14B-scale models with Self-Forcing typically requires industrial-scale GPU infrastructure [ 55 ] , whereas removing both auxiliary score networks also enables us to train a 14B generator on only 8 GPUs, and achieves stronger results than the industrial autoregressive video generation models under matched evaluation settings. We further conduct additional experiments with different reference collections, including monochrome appearance, character-specific content, and panoramic composition, demonstrating that Elastic Forcing can adapt to novel concepts beyond the capabilities of a fixed teacher.
paragraphs.zh: 在与 1.3B 生成器匹配的初始化和评估条件下，Elastic Forcing 的 VBench [ 38 ] 总分为 84.64，高于 Self Forcing 的 83.80，同时保持了相同的推理效率。 使用 Self-Forcing 训练 14B 规模的模型通常需要工业级的 GPU 基础设施 [ 55 ]，而移除两个辅助评分网络后，我们仅用 8 块 GPU 即可训练一个 14B 生成器，并在匹配的评估设置下取得了比工业级自回归视频生成模型更强的结果。 我们还进一步使用不同的参考集进行了额外实验，包括单色外观、角色特定内容和全景构图，结果表明 Elastic Forcing 能够适应固定教师模型能力之外的新概念。

paragraphs.en: We consider diffusion-based generators that synthesize each chunk in a small number of denoising steps, combining causal generation across chunks with few-step sampling within each chunk [ 88 , 37 ] . Self Forcing [ 37 ] trains on autoregressive rollouts whose histories consist of previously generated chunks, rather than ground-truth histories, and supervises the resulting video distribution.
paragraphs.zh: 我们考虑基于扩散的生成器，它们通过少量去噪步骤合成每个片段，将跨片段的因果生成与每个片段内的少步采样相结合 [ 88 , 37 ] 。 Self Forcing [ 37 ] 在自回归展开上进行训练，其历史由先前生成的片段组成，而非真实历史，并对由此产生的视频分布进行监督。

paragraphs.en: Distribution Matching Distillation (DMD) [ 87 , 86 ] provides one such distributional objective. paragraphs.en: Elastic Forcing matches few-step autoregressive rollouts to reference videos using MMD in frozen representation spaces. Its design addresses the statistical–computational trade-off of video distribution learning in two complementary ways. Hybrid reference estimation improves the accuracy–stability balance when reference minibatches are limited, while estimation–differentiation decoupling allows a larger rollout population to inform the loss than is backpropagated through the generator. We first define the video matching objective (Section 3.1 ), then develop the hybrid estimator (Section 3.2 ) and selective differentiation scheme (Section 3.3 ).
paragraphs.zh: Elastic Forcing 利用 MMD 在冻结的表示空间中，将少数步的自回归展开与参考视频进行匹配。 其设计通过两种互补的方式，解决了视频分布学习中统计性与计算性之间的权衡问题。 当参考小批量受限时，混合参考估计能够提升准确性与稳定性的平衡；而估计-微分解耦则使得比通过生成器反向传播的展开种群更大的规模能够影响损失函数。 我们首先定义视频匹配目标（第 3.1 节），然后开发混合估计器（第 3.2 节）和选择性微分方案（第 3.3 节）。

paragraphs.en: Setup. We evaluate generation quality, the components of Elastic Forcing, and its scalability from 1.3B to 14B parameters. Our 1.3B experiments use the same autoregressive architecture, ODE-initialized checkpoint, and rollout procedure as Self Forcing [ 37 ] . For elastic-forcing training, we use over 8,000 Wan-generated reference videos [ 72 ] with prompts expanded from VidProM [ 75 ] ; these samples, rather than online teacher scores, define the training target. Following Self Forcing, we evaluate on expanded versions of the 946 official VBench prompts [ 38 ] , generating five videos per prompt with independent random seeds. We train Elastic Forcing, both the three- and two-encoder variant (with and without DINO) on 4 NVIDIA H200 GPUs with distribution batch B = 256 B=256 and differentiation batch b = 128 b=128 . Further implementation details are provided in Appendix B .
paragraphs.zh: 设置。 我们评估了生成质量、Elastic Forcing 的各个组件，以及其从 13 亿到 140 亿参数的可扩展性。 我们的 13 亿参数实验采用了与 Self Forcing [37] 相同的自回归架构、ODE 初始化的检查点以及展开流程。 对于弹性强制训练，我们使用了超过 8,000 个由 Wan 生成的参考视频 [72]，其提示词来自 VidProM [75] 的扩展；这些样本而非在线教师评分定义了训练目标。 遵循 Self Forcing 的方法，我们在 946 个官方 VBench 提示词 [38] 的扩展版本上进行评估，每个提示词生成五个使用独立随机种子生成的视频。 我们在 4 块 NVIDIA H200 GPU 上训练了 Elastic Forcing，包括三编码器变体和双编码器变体（分别包含和不包含 DINO），分布批大小为 B = 256，微分批大小为 b = 128。 更多实现细节见附录 B。

paragraphs.en: Table 1 compares Elastic Forcing with representative bidirectional and autoregressive video generators. The baseline methods are described in Appendix B.3 . Our model (two-encoder) achieves VBench Total, Quality, and Semantic scores of 84.64, 85.43, and 81.48, respectively, outperforming all listed autoregressive baselines while retaining 17 FPS inference. Note that Elastic Forcing modifies only the training objective and is orthogonal to existing advances in RoPE [ 67 ] , memory mechanisms [ 85 , 51 ] , and initialization, which can be incorporated independently. The Total score also exceeds that of bidirectional Wan2.1 (84.26). These results show that direct sample-based supervision can support competitive streaming generation without teacher-provided target scores. The three-encoder variant achieves slightly lower VBench scores, but still outperforms all autoregressive baselines. This variant demonstrates better qualitative abilities, discussed in Section 4.2 .

paragraphs.en: Representation space. V-JEPA 2 and VideoMAE individually reach VBench Total scores of 83.91 and 83.97, whereas combining them achieves 84.64. DINOv3 alone scores 81.96 on VBench but 3.27 under the VLM judge, exceeding either video encoder (2.40 and 2.67). This disagreement motivates evaluating representation choices with both protocols. Adding DINOv3 to the two video encoders lowers VBench Total from 84.64 to 83.81, but raises the VLM score from 3.03 to 3.63, the best in Table 2 . This agrees with our observation of improved temporal stability. We report both variants in the main comparison and use all three encoders in subsequent experiments; Appendix D.1 provides further analysis.

paragraphs.en: Autoregressive video training addresses imperfect histories through denoising, rollout-level distillation, or adversarial supervision [ 12 , 30 , 37 , 48 ] . Sample-based distributional objectives offer an alternative to online score models by comparing generated and reference populations in learned representation spaces [ 46 , 18 , 84 , 23 , 93 ] . Our work connects these directions through efficient kernel matching of autoregressive rollouts. Appendix A reviews autoregressive video generation, distributional training, and video representation learning in more detail.

paragraphs.en: We introduced Elastic Forcing, a sample-based framework for post-training few-step autoregressive video generators. By matching rollout distributions to reference videos through MMD in frozen representation spaces, it removes the need for both a diffusion teacher and an online fake-score model during post-training. Hybrid reference estimation balances approximation bias and sampling variance, while decoupling distribution estimation from differentiation makes large rollout batches practical under memory constraints.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 Elastic Forcing，这是一种基于样本的框架，用于后训练少步自回归视频生成器。 通过在冻结表示空间中利用 MMD 将展开分布与参考视频进行匹配，该方法在训练后无需扩散教师模型和在线虚假评分模型。 混合参考估计能够平衡近似偏差和采样方差，而将分布估计与微分解耦则使得在内存受限条件下使用较大的展开批次成为可能。

paragraphs.en: Autoregressive generators predict ordered visual tokens or continuous latent chunks [ 83 , 42 , 80 , 17 ] , including action-conditioned world modeling [ 8 ] . Independent temporal noise levels and history guidance connect sequence prediction with diffusion [ 12 , 65 ] , enabling long-video synthesis at scale [ 13 , 1 ] . Pyramidal computation, queued denoising, cache reuse, and context compression improve streaming efficiency [ 40 , 41 , 25 , 96 , 90 ] . To reduce exposure bias, self-resampled histories and recycled generation errors expose denoising models to imperfect contexts during training [ 30 , 45 ] . Another line distills bidirectional models into causal generators [ 88 ] and supervises self-generated rollouts to reduce the train–test gap [ 37 ] . Subsequent work improves causal initialization, rolling generation, reward guidance, and context-gradient reconstruction [ 97 , 51 , 54 , 98 ] . Long-context supervision and memory mechanisms address temporal consistency [ 85 , 14 , 82 ] , while on-policy self-distillation and diagonal denoising schedules offer further training and streaming strategies [ 49 , 50 ] . Adversarial post-training instead learns through a discriminator, with generated histories supporting real-time interactive synthesis [ 47 , 48 , 92 ] . We retain autoregressive rollout training but replace online score-based supervision with a reference-sample objective.

paragraphs.en: Distributional objectives compare generated and target populations without paired outputs. Maximum mean discrepancy measures differences between kernel mean embeddings [ 66 , 29 , 57 ] and directly trains generators from samples [ 46 , 20 ] ; adversarially learned representations strengthen these objectives [ 44 , 7 ] . Energy distances and sliced optimal transport provide other sample-based discrepancies [ 5 , 19 ] , while entropically regularized transport connects transport costs and kernel matching [ 28 , 24 ] . Distribution evolution can also be described by kernel or sliced-transport gradient flows [ 2 , 53 ] , or learned through data-attraction and sample-repulsion fields [ 18 ] . Memory-efficient feature-distribution training already separates large statistical populations from smaller replay batches [ 43 ] . Recent approaches optimize Fréchet feature moments with decoupled estimation and differentiation [ 84 ] , or use multiple frozen encoders and persistent kernel summaries [ 23 ] . Unlike score-based distribution distillation [ 87 , 86 ] , these sample-based objectives can learn from reference data without an online diffusion teacher. We apply this perspective to autoregressive video rollouts, combining hybrid reference estimation with selective differentiation under video-training memory constraints.

paragraphs.en: Video encoders capture temporal structure through three-dimensional convolutions, multiple temporal rates, or space–time attention [ 9 , 22 , 6 , 60 , 52 ] . Self-supervised objectives include dense predictive coding and temporal contrastive learning [ 32 , 62 ] , masked pixel or feature reconstruction [ 69 , 21 , 77 , 74 ] , and prediction in learned latent spaces [ 4 , 3 ] . Video–text alignment and large-scale multimodal pretraining enrich semantic features [ 81 , 76 , 73 ] ; image self-distillation and language–image alignment supply complementary appearance cues [ 59 , 64 , 63 , 91 ] . Pretrained representations also improve generation by aligning denoiser states with clean-image features [ 89 ] , which differs from matching distributions of completed outputs. Feature selection remains important: video distances can underweight temporal defects [ 70 , 27 ] , and optimizing one representation can conceal perceptual failures [ 84 , 23 ] . This motivates combining video and image encoders and assessing them with complementary automatic and human judgments.
paragraphs.zh: 视频编码器通过三维卷积、多种时间速率或时空注意力机制来捕捉时间结构 [ 9 , 22 , 6 , 60 , 52 ] 。 自监督目标包括密集预测编码和时间对比学习 [ 32 , 62 ] 、掩码像素或特征重建 [ 69 , 21 , 77 , 74 ] ，以及在已学习的潜在空间中进行预测 [ 4 , 3 ] 。 视频与文本的对齐以及大规模多模态预训练能够丰富语义特征 [ 81 , 76 , 73 ] ；图像自蒸馏和语言与图像的对齐则提供了互补的外观线索 [ 59 , 64 , 63 , 91 ] 。 预训练表示还能通过使去噪器状态与干净图像的特征对齐来改进生成效果 [ 89 ] ，这与匹配已完成输出的分布不同。 特征选择仍然很重要：视频距离可能会低估时间缺陷 [ 70 , 27 ] ，而优化单一表示则可能掩盖感知上的失败 [ 84 , 23 ] 。 这促使我们将视频编码器和图像编码器相结合，并通过互补的自动评估和人工判断来对它们进行评估。

paragraphs.en: CausVid [ 88 ] distills a bidirectional diffusion model into a few-step causal generator. Self-Forcing [ 37 ] applies distributional supervision to rollouts conditioned on their own generated histories, reducing the mismatch between training and inference. LongLive [ 85 ] extends this setting with long-horizon tuning, persistent frame-sink tokens, and prompt-dependent KV recaching. Rolling Forcing [ 51 ] uses joint denoising within rolling temporal windows and persistent attention sinks. Reward Forcing [ 54 ] combines reward-guided distribution matching with an evolving memory of earlier frames. The evaluated variants in this family retain score-based supervision. Elastic Forcing instead changes how the rollout distribution is supervised, and can be combined with improvements to temporal context or memory handling.
paragraphs.zh: CausVid [ 88 ] 将双向扩散模型提炼为一种只需少数步骤的因果生成器。 Self-Forcing [ 37 ] 对以自身生成的历史为条件的展开过程应用分布监督，从而减少训练与推理之间的不匹配。 LongLive [ 85 ] 通过长时程调优、持续帧沉记号以及依赖提示的 KV 重新缓存扩展了这一设定。 Rolling Forcing [ 51 ] 在滚动时间窗口内使用联合去噪，并采用持续的注意力沉记号。 Reward Forcing [ 54 ] 将奖励引导的分布匹配与对早期帧的演化记忆相结合。 该系列中经过评估的变体仍保留基于分数的监督机制。 Elastic Forcing 则改变了展开过程分布的监督方式，并可结合时间上下文或记忆处理的改进方案。

paragraphs.en: To reproduce the intended backward computation, the saved replay state must permit reconstruction of the same random choices and segment inputs. Reverse execution restores a boundary, reconstructs that segment, propagates its incoming cotangent, and releases the segment’s graph [ 15 , 26 ] . Frozen encoder weights still permit derivatives with respect to their inputs. Reusing the same random choices, preprocessing, and parameter values is essential: replaying a different video would pair a cotangent with the wrong Jacobian. Boundary gradients must be propagated wherever the original computation requires them; detaching a boundary introduces truncation rather than an equivalent memory-saving execution. The optimizer is updated only after all selected contributions have been accumulated.
paragraphs.zh: 为了重现预期的反向计算，保存的重播状态必须允许重建相同的随机选择和分段输入。 反向执行会恢复一个边界、重建该分段、传播其传入的余切向量，并释放该分段的图 [ 15 , 26 ] 。 冻结的编码器权重仍然允许对其输入求导。 重复使用相同的随机选择、预处理和参数值至关重要：重播不同的视频会将一个余切向量与错误的雅可比矩阵配对。 边界梯度必须在原始计算需要它们的所有位置被传播；脱离边界会导致截断，而不是等效的节省内存的执行方式。 只有在所有选定的贡献项都被累加之后，优化器才会被更新。

paragraphs.en: Elastic Forcing removes online diffusion score models from distributional post-training, but continues to depend on pretrained generators, frozen representation encoders, and suitable reference data. Matching feature distributions can miss errors to which the encoders are insensitive. Even with a characteristic kernel in feature space [ 66 , 57 ] , equal feature distributions need not imply equal video distributions if the representation discards information. Video-marginal matching also does not by itself identify the correct video distribution for every text condition.
paragraphs.zh: Elastic Forcing 方法将在线扩散评分模型从分布后训练阶段移除，但仍需依赖预训练的生成器、冻结的表示编码器以及合适的参考数据。 匹配特征分布可能会遗漏编码器无法敏感检测到的错误。 即使在特征空间中使用了特征核 [66, 57]，如果表示过程丢弃了信息，特征分布相等并不必然意味着视频分布也相等。 仅通过视频边缘分布匹配本身，也无法为每个文本条件确定正确的视频分布。

paragraphs.en: The persistent reference summary introduces finite-rank and regularization error, and selective differentiation adds gradient-sampling variance. Increasing the distribution batch still requires more forward computation. The FIFO ablation shows why stale representations should not be assumed to preserve the properties of fresh rollouts. paragraphs.en: Figure 9 shows results using Motionformer [ 60 ] and InternVideo-Next [ 73 ] representations. Motionformer uses action-category supervision, while InternVideo-Next combines self-supervised video learning with additional semantic priors. The examples contain blurred objects, changes in appearance, and loss of scene structure over time. A possible explanation is that representations suited to recognition may be insensitive to details needed for synthesis. These qualitative observations concern the tested configurations and do not establish that supervised video encoders are unsuitable in general.
paragraphs.zh: 图9展示了使用 Motionformer [60] 和 InternVideo-Next [73] 表示方法得到的结果。 Motionformer 采用动作类别监督，而 InternVideo-Next 则将自监督视频学习与额外的语义先验相结合。 这些示例包含模糊物体、外观变化以及随时间推移的场景结构丢失。 一种可能的解释是，适合识别的表示方法可能对合成所需的细节不敏感。 这些定性观察仅针对所测试的配置，并不能证明监督式视频编码器在总体上就不适用。

paragraphs.en: As shown in Figure 11 , the quantitative results are also reflected in generation quality. Pure Nyström estimation produces duplicated or inconsistent liquid streams, while pure Monte Carlo estimation leads to unstable bottle geometry and discontinuous pouring dynamics, as highlighted by the red circles. Combining the two estimators better preserves object structure and produces a coherent stream and smoothly expanding puddle over time.
paragraphs.zh: 如图 11 所示，定量结果也反映在生成质量上。 纯 Nyström 估计会产生重复或不一致的液体流，而纯 Monte Carlo 估计则会导致瓶子几何结构不稳定以及倒液动力学不连续，如红圈所示。 结合这两种估计方法能更好地保留物体结构，并随时间推移产生连贯的液体流和逐渐扩展的液池。

paragraphs.en: We compare joint text–video representation matching with video-only matching on Wan2.1-T2V-14B. Table 9 shows decreases of 0.77 points in VBench Total, 0.89 in Quality, and 0.30 in Semantic for the joint formulation. The generator remains text-conditioned in both cases; “video only” describes the loss space. Adding text features changes the matching geometry and relative feature scales, which may explain the observed degradation. This result supports the tested video-only configuration, but neither establishes that text information is redundant nor guarantees prompt-conditional alignment from matching the video marginal.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在 Wan2.1-T2V-14B 上对比了联合文本–视频表示匹配与仅视频匹配的效果。 表 9 显示，联合方法在 VBench Total、Quality 和 Semantic 指标上的得分分别下降了 0.77 分、0.89 分和 0.30 分。 在这两种情况下，生成器都保持对文本的条件依赖；“仅视频”描述的是损失空间。 添加文本特征会改变匹配的几何结构和相对特征尺度，这或许可以解释所观察到的性能下降。 这一结果支持了所测试的仅视频配置，但既不能证明文本信息是冗余的，也不能保证通过匹配视频边缘分布就能实现提示条件对齐。

paragraphs.en: A Fréchet-distance (FD) objective summarizes a d d -dimensional representation with a mean and a d × d d\times d covariance matrix [ 35 , 70 , 84 ] . Dense covariance storage costs O ⁡ ( d 2 ) O(d^{2}) and matrix factorizations can cost O ⁡ ( d 3 ) O(d^{3}) , which is restrictive for representations retaining many video tokens. Pooling reduces this cost but also removes information the loss could constrain.
paragraphs.zh: Fréchet距离（FD）目标通过均值和一个 d × d 协方差矩阵来概括一个 d 维表示 [35, 70, 84]。 密集存储协方差需要 O(d²) 的空间，而矩阵分解的成本可能达到 O(d³)，这对于保留大量视频标记的表示来说是一种限制。 池化可以降低这种成本，但也会移除损失函数本可以约束的信息。

sents.en: A Fréchet-distance (FD) objective summarizes a d d -dimensional representation with a mean and a d × d d\times d covariance matrix [ 35 , 70 , 84 ] .
sents.zh: Fréchet距离（FD）目标通过均值和一个 d × d 协方差矩阵来概括一个 d 维表示 [35, 70, 84]。

sents.en: Dense covariance storage costs O ⁡ ( d 2 ) O(d^{2}) and matrix factorizations can cost O ⁡ ( d 3 ) O(d^{3}) , which is restrictive for representations retaining many video tokens.

paragraphs.en: MMD uses pairwise kernels without constructing the covariance matrix. The Nyström summary reduces reference comparisons, and selective replay controls generator backpropagation. Direct generated–generated evaluation still costs O ⁡ ( B 2 ) O(B^{2}) kernel evaluations, and representation and kernel choices remain consequential. Our exploratory sparse-feature FD experiment produced blurred samples (Figure 12 ), motivating dense feature matching. This observation concerns the tested configuration, rather than all FD formulations.
paragraphs.zh: MMD 使用成对核函数，而无需构建协方差矩阵。 Nyström 摘要减少了参考比较，而选择性重播则控制生成器的反向传播。 直接生成的生成评估仍然需要 O(B²) 次核函数计算，且表示和核函数的选择依然至关重要。 我们探索性的稀疏特征 FD 实验产生了模糊的样本（图 12），这促使我们采用密集特征匹配。 这一观察结果与所测试的配置有关，而非所有 FD 公式。

sents.en: MMD uses pairwise kernels without constructing the covariance matrix.
sents.zh: MMD 使用成对核函数，而无需构建协方差矩阵。

sents.en: The Nyström summary reduces reference comparisons, and selective replay controls generator backpropagation.

paragraphs.en: Our standard T2V backbones rely on ODE initialization before few-step autoregressive post-training. This initialization bridges both a sampling change, from a longer denoising trajectory to four steps, and a structural change, from bidirectional generation to causal chunks. In experiments omitting this initialization, individual chunks can remain visually plausible while continuity across chunks deteriorates. Local frame quality therefore does not by itself establish coherent streaming generation.
paragraphs.zh: 我们标准的 T2V 主干模型在少步自回归后训练之前，依赖于 ODE 初始化。 这种初始化同时实现了采样方式的转变——从更长的去噪轨迹转为四步去噪，以及结构上的转变——从双向生成转为因果分块生成。 在省略该初始化的实验中，单个分块可能仍然在视觉上合理，但分块之间的连贯性会下降。 因此，局部帧的质量本身并不能确保生成连贯的流式内容。

paragraphs.en: We examine whether stronger visual conditioning can ease this transition using Wan2.1-14B VACE [ 39 ] with first-frame and optical-flow conditioning. The first frame constrains appearance, and optical flow supplies motion information. Starting directly from the pretrained VACE checkpoint, we use 100 updates with MMD and an auxiliary regression objective, followed by 100 updates with MMD alone. This totals 200 post-training updates and omits a separate ODE initialization stage; the first stage still includes regression supervision.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用 Wan2.1-14B VACE [39]，结合首帧和光流条件约束，研究更强的视觉条件约束是否能缓解这一过渡过程。 首帧用于约束外观，而光流则提供运动信息。 我们从预训练的 VACE 检查点直接开始，首先使用 MMD 和辅助回归目标进行 100 次更新，随后仅使用 MMD 再进行 100 次更新。 这总共包含 200 次后训练更新，且省略了独立的 ODE 初始化阶段；第一阶段仍包含回归监督。

paragraphs.en: Figure 16 supplements the 14B evaluation in Table 5 . Both methods use 14B backbones, and our post-training starts from the same initialization used for the comparison. paragraphs.en: Listing presents the prompt for evaluating each video independently. The evaluator receives three chronological contact sheets containing a total of 12 uniformly sampled frames, together with the original text prompt used to generate the video. It assigns a score from 0 to 100 to each of four dimensions: visual quality, subject consistency, temporal coherence, and semantic consistency, and provides a short supporting explanation. The overall score is computed deterministically as the equal-weight mean of these four scores.
paragraphs.zh: 列表展示了用于独立评估每个视频的提示词。 评估器会收到三张按时间顺序排列的接触片，其中共包含 12 个均匀采样的帧，以及生成视频时使用的原始文本提示词。 它会对四个维度分别给出 0 到 100 的分数：视觉质量、主体一致性、时间连贯性和语义一致性，并提供简短的支持性解释。 总分会通过确定性的方式计算得出，即这四个分数的等权平均值。

paragraphs.en: Listing presents the instruction prompt for comparing multi videos corresponding to the same official short prompt. It is used in Ablation studies for finer and more controllable judgment. Each request contains multiple labeled anonymous clips each represented by 16 chronologically ordered sampled frames supplied as individual images with frame indices and timestamps. The shared official short prompt and labeled image sequences are supplied in the accompanying user message. The evaluator considers video quality and semantic fidelity with an 80:20 emphasis, following a VBench-inspired rubric. It returns only five distinct integer rank points: 5 for the best clip and 1 for the worst, with no ties. For each method, we report the mean rank points across evaluated groups. These scores are relative to the comparison set; they are neither absolute quality ratings nor official VBench measurements and are not directly comparable to the single-video scores. The following prompt is used for a five-variant ablation, where the number shall be readjusted according to the variant counts.
paragraphs.zh: 列表展示了用于比较与相同官方简短提示相对应的多个视频的指令提示。 它被用于消融研究中，以实现更精细且更具可控性的判断。 每个请求都包含多个带标签的匿名片段，每个片段由 16 个按时间顺序排列的采样帧表示，这些帧作为带有帧索引和时间戳的独立图像提供。 共享的官方简短提示和带标签的图像序列在随附的用户消息中提供。 评估器遵循受 VBench 启发的评分标准，以 80:20 的权重关注视频质量和语义保真度。 它仅返回五个不同的整数排名分数：最佳片段得 5 分，最差片段得 1 分，且不存在并列情况。 对于每种方法，我们报告在评估组中的平均排名分数。 这些分数是相对于比较集而言的；它们既不是绝对的质量评分，也不是官方的 VBench 测量值，并且无法与单视频分数直接比较。 以下提示用于包含五个变体的消融研究，其中数字应根据变体数量重新调整。

paragraphs.en: We conduct a blinded human evaluation comparing Krea Realtime 14B with Ours-14B. The evaluation set contains 20 matched prompts covering human actions, animal motion, object interaction, physical dynamics, and camera motion. Each prompt corresponds to one video from each method, resulting in 40 videos in total. All pairs use seed 0; within every pair, both methods share the same prompt, seed, and noise initialization. All videos contain 81 frames at 16 fps with a resolution of 832 × 480 832\times 480 .
paragraphs.zh: 我们进行了一项盲测式人类评估，将 Krea Realtime 14B 与 Ours-14B 进行了比较。 评估集包含 20 个匹配的提示，涵盖了人类动作、动物运动、物体交互、物理动态和相机运动。 每个提示对应每种方法生成的一个视频，因此总共包含 40 个视频。 所有对比对均使用种子值 0；在每一对对比中，两种方法都共享相同的提示、种子值和噪声初始化。 所有视频均包含 81 帧，帧率为 16 fps，分辨率为 832 × 480 832\times 480 。

paragraphs.en: A total of 42 participants completed the evaluation. Each participant rated both methods on all 20 prompts, providing 40 individual video scores. This produced 42 × 20 = 840 42\times 20=840 ratings per method and 1,680 individual scores in total. For every participant, prompt order was randomized independently. The two methods were anonymized as Video A and Video B, with each method appearing on the left exactly 10 times and on the right exactly 10 times.
